raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 28 txn_ids delivered as two versions (record_version 1 and 2, same batch) that differ only in amount, so the second version is a correction. The silver step keeps both copies, which duplicates keys and double-counts amounts in every gold table. Keeping only the latest record_version per txn_id before the POSTED filter fixes silver and all downstream gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
